notablePrerequisites: Stormrider Rig attached to Blood Pet.
description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Koll triggers, returning Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Stormrider Rig triggers, attaching itself to Blood Pet.
Repeat.
